name: cadence-monorepo
description: Cadence — human-realistic typing engine and tooling.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cadence/engine && npm run build --workspace @cadence/playwright && npm run build --workspace @cadence/cypress && npm run build --workspace @cadence/ai
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @cadence/playwright && npm run typecheck --workspace @cadence/cypress && npm run typecheck --workspace @cadence/ai
scripts.test:unit: npm test --workspace @cadence/engine && npm test --workspace @cadence/cypress && npm test --workspace @cadence/ai
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
